name: athena-militaria
description: Site Athena Militaria. Le frontend est statique et n'a pas de build ; ce fichier ne sert qu'à lancer les tests du parcours de paiement.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:db
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/courriels.test.ts tests/error-messages.test.ts tests/fulfillment.test.ts tests/guides-faq.test.ts tests/guides-sources.test.ts tests/langue-et-recherche.test.ts tests/payments.test.ts tests/protection-acheteurs.test.ts tests/sql-contract.test.ts tests/taxonomie.test.ts tests/textes-paiement.test.ts tests/vendeur-pas-pret.test.ts tests/vendeur-pas-pret-front.test.ts tests/veille-site.test.ts tests/webhook-signature.test.ts
scripts.test:db: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/db-migration.test.ts tests/db-payments.test.ts tests/db-payout.test.ts tests/db-security.test.ts tests/db-vendeur-pas-pret.test.ts
